digest.component_or_area: binding store rotation and GET state persistence
propositions: Introduce a new rotation sidecar file .bridge_state/get_rotation.json that stores GET rotation state alongside the legacy inline field during a dual-write rollout window.
Read the maximum of sidecar and legacy inline values for each Jira key; write every new rotation stamp to both sidecar and legacy field until the legacy write is removed in a follow-up change.
Persist the rotation sidecar only through BindingStore.save() paths (end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, retirement), not during reconcile-check reads.
An idempotent pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD after rotation state initialization.
A pass with absent-key GETs advances the same selected Jira-key stamps in both get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields, staged and committed explicitly without git add -A.
An interleaved old-binary and new-binary pass sequence produces the same rotation order as an all-new sequence, requiring both dual-write and max-based lookup to function correctly.
